fields.label: Session ID
fields.help: Existing chat session to continue (from a previous run's session_id output). Omit to start a new chat.

fields.label: Response Mode
fields.help: image mode waits for generated images and downloads them to downloadDir.

fields.label: Reference Image Path
fields.help: Local image to upload before the prompt is sent (e.g. for style transfer).

fields.label: Max Wait (seconds)
fields.help: Maximum time to wait for each Gemini response.

fields.label: Download Directory
fields.help: Where to save generated images (image mode only).
